QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in the shipped config (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`, `//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are commented out too (lines 2185 and 2196).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the shipped config leaves MBEDTLS_THREADING_C, THREADING_PTHREAD and THREADING_ALT all commented out, so a default build defines none of them.
